name: cost-optimization-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal cost optimization actions based on resource usage patterns and historical optimization outcomes

options.description: Reduce the number of running instances to match actual workload demand
Replace on-demand instances with cheaper spot/preemptible instances
Change instance type to better match workload resource requirements
Configure auto-scaling policies to dynamically adjust capacity based on demand
Move data to more cost-effective storage tiers based on access patterns

evaluation_factors: Current resource usage metrics (CPU, memory, disk utilization)
Historical success rates for each optimization action in similar situations
Risk and impact of each action on service performance and availability
Estimated cost savings potential for each approach
Performance trade-offs associated with different optimization strategies
